entry.title: New: Bill 225 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 14-54 WHICH AMENDED SECTION 25-8-26 (PĀHOA ZONE MAP), ARTICLE 8, CHAPTER 25 (ZONING CODE) OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), BY CHANGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM AGRICULTURAL – 1 ACRE (A-1a) TO VILLAGE COMMERCIAL – 20,000 SQUARE FEET (CV-20) AT KEONEPOKO HOMESTEAD LOTS, PUNA, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 1-5-007:061 (Applicant

Maui Varieties Investments Inc. (formerly Jerry Souza)) (Area: 1 acre) The Windward Planning Commission forwards its favorable recommendation for the applicant’s request for a 10-year time extension to Condition C (Establishment of a Commercial Use), and an amendment to Condition H (Road Improvements). The property is located at 15-1447 Kahakai Boulevard.

Latest action: Council: Bill 225 passes second & final reading - 01/08/25
